name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the exit while carrying the box, but the compiled clauses lack any hard goal that makes reaching the exit mandatory. No Existence(at_exit) (or equivalent) is present, so the episode could finish without ever reaching the exit, which violates the task. Also, the current Precedence(holding_box, at_exit) only prevents exiting before the first time the box is held; it does not ensure the box is still held at the exit (the agent could drop the box after picking it up and still exit). To capture “carry the box to the exit” you need a hard goal Existence(at_exit) and a rule that the exit requires the box to be held, e.g., a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) (or an equivalent clause such as a hard Precedence(at_exit, holding_box) combined with the goal). Add these clauses and recompile.

texts: The agent must eventually be at the exit.
When the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box at that step.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again on the very next move.
